evidence: Modifies `src/streams.h` to make `BufferedWriter`'s destructor safe and non-throwing, adding explicit `discard()` and `Assume` checks.
rationale: Fixes a regression in stream primitives where unflushed write failures triggered an immediate `std::terminate` crash instead of handled exceptions. As reviewer ryanofsky notes, giving `BufferedWriter` a safer interface where writers flush or discard explicitly removes dangerous destructor re-throws.
